provider.transport: AGY subscription, exact text-only transport not yet qualified
provider.reason: Proposed by upstream frontier-feasibility report; new experiment, not a replacement in historical Flash results
provider.returnedServingIdentity: must capture actual available identifiers; requested alias is not immutable weight revision

budget.forecast: No defensible exact debit forecast. Thresholds are proposed policy, not an estimate or a promise to complete 48 cells.
budget.observations: Fresh readings before each subject and after each result; account-wide usage counts conservatively; stop on missing/stale/reset/nonmonotonic data.
budget.overshoot: One subject may cross an observed allowance; rounding, delay, concurrent use and provider-side work prevent a hard subscription cap.

stopPolicy: Any tool, repository, ancestor-rule, global-skill, session-reuse or controller leakage
Observed quota threshold, quota reset, unavailable reading or stale reading
First timeout, partial/truncated transport capture, unknown remote outcome or infrastructure error
Whole-batch deadline; retain partial pairs and every unattempted cell

scoring.primary: Source-backed correctness and critical accessibility errors by paired scenario/family and platform
scoring.claim: Bundled dev.5 plus scoped reference usefulness versus generic baseline; not installed activation, dev.6 lift or pure prompt isolation
scoring.calibration: 96 authored exemplar slots (four types for 24 scenarios), 312 criterion judgments; not executed or accepted

required: Exact qualified provider/client/requested model and actual supported isolation
Independent transport/source evidence review and completed controller calibration
Fresh quota observations plus approved percentage-point allowances
Explicit acknowledgment of unsupported hard token/internal-request caps and one-subject overshoot
Separate owner execution approval for this comparison identity
